messages.text: when will batch 1 be shipped for magicminer 40t
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Read the magic miner 40t page

Batch 1 isn't shipping on its own any more. All 300 units of this production run are built and will go out from the factory together. Magic M. expects them to leave the factory on November 12.

That's the date they leave the factory, not the date they reach you. If you have an order, we email the tracking as soon as your miner ships. You can follow the shipment to our warehouse on the shipment status page: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I'm sorry this has taken longer than the dates we gave at first. Did you already order one, or are you thinking about buying?
but it says on page ships october 31?

You're right, the page said October 31, and we didn't make that date. I'm sorry. We've given dates on this miner that we didn't keep, and that's on us.

Here's what happened. The first production run was paused to fix a control board issue. That's fixed now and the final version is approved. The current word is that all units ship out from the factory on November 12. Then they still have to get to our warehouses before they go out to buyers.

Do you already have an order, or are you deciding whether to buy one?
ok. what about batch 10. still on same date, 21. december?
Searched the catalog · Magic M. 40T

Yes. Batch 10 is the one on sale now, and it ships December 21, 2026. It's $799 for 40 TH/s, and that batch has 50 units.

When the miner ships, the tracking is emailed to you.

Here's the link if you want to grab one: https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48890366853375:1

Anything else you'd like to know first, like power draw, noise or where you'd run it?
yes but it will be shipped on dec 21 or this is a rough estimate

December 21 is the date we're planning to ship batch 10, and it's the date your order would carry. I can't call it a guarantee, though. We've missed dates on this miner before, so I'd rather be straight with you.

The good sign is that the production problem behind the earlier delays is fixed. The current run is due to leave the factory on November 12. If anything changes, we email you the new date, and tracking comes as soon as your miner ships.

Would that timing work for you?
ok what about batch 5?

Batch 5 is sold out. Batch 10 is the only one you can buy now.

Batch 5 units are part of the current production run, and all of those leave the factory together on November 12. From there they go to our warehouses and then out to buyers. Tracking is emailed when each miner ships.

If you have a batch 5 order, send me the order number and I'll check exactly where yours stands.
yes i know. i want to know about when will batch 5 ship

I don't have a separate ship date to give you for batch 5. Batches 1 to 10 aren't being shipped one after another any more. The whole current run, batch 5 included, leaves the factory together on November 12.

After that the units still have to travel to our warehouses and be checked in, and only then do they go out to buyers. I don't have a firm date for that last step yet, so I won't guess one.

You can follow the shipment to our warehouse on the shipment status page: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
ok so from batch 1 to 5 ships together on nov 12, next is batch 6 on nov 21?
